dataset: Wang J.-X., Qian J., Wang H., Sun M., Wu L., Zhong M., Chen Y., Mao Y., Chem. Eng. J. 485:149467 (2024), co-flowing microfluidic droplet generation; data deposit Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.10526441 (CC BY 4.0), file 'Data for FrameworkA.xlsx'
intake_basis: header row, row count (830), level counts of the input and grouping columns, numeric-cell count of the target column; no target value was read before this binding was written (DATASET_CANDIDATES_round2.md section 0)

dimensionless_definitions.unit_note: the flow-rate unit is not stated in the deposit; velocities and hence Ca and Re carry one unknown constant factor each, which does not affect tree models and cancels in the C2 equality test (5% tolerance)

excluded_from_inputs: flowtype (observed regime, kept as a descriptive meta column)
channel (device key; redundant with inner/outer for the two devices)
columns.target_unit: as in file; the deposit does not state the unit of the diameter column (MAPE, tau and the shift multipliers are unit-free)

groups.S0: row-random 80/20 inside the development set, seeds 0-14
groups.S1: s1_group = fluid pair x device (GroupShuffleSplit 80/20, seeds 0-14; also the dev-ref grouping)
groups.S2: s2_group = fluid pair (combination of the five physical-property columns; 11 levels in the intake)
groups.S3: s3_group = device instance (inner, outer, channel; 2 levels in the intake)
groups.S4_note: no device-type class exists (both devices are co-flow capillaries)

sealing_rules.S2: among s2_group levels with >= 10 target rows, excluding every level that attains the maximum count, choose the level whose count is closest to the median of the eligible counts; ties -> lexicographically smallest level name
sealing_rules.S3: same rule on s3_group levels; if the chosen level's rows intersect the S2 sealed rows, take the next candidate; if none remains, S3 is not sealed

parsing_rules.experiment_row: a row with numeric values in all native input columns and channel
parsing_rules.missing_target: rows without a numeric diameter are dropped and counted
parsing_rules.nonpositive_target: rows with diameter <= 0 are dropped and counted before any grouping decision (A1 v2 rule)

hard_bound_note: no physical upper bound is defined for a co-flow droplet; the bounded model is the log-target MLP, the unbounded model the raw-scale MLP (H-B B1 only)
anchor_note: the paper's model is a neural network, not a correlation; H-B B2 is not evaluable on this dataset

tolerance.absolute_rule: 0.10 x development-set median target (computed by the custodian from development labels and written to the devdiag file)

target_scale_rule: development labels only: log target if max/min > 10 or skewness > 2, else raw scale
